limitations_and_boundaries: The study focuses on human single-cell transcriptomes; applicability to other species or data types is not directly addressed.
Experimental validation was limited to dilated cardiomyopathy with TTN truncating mutations; other diseases may require further validation.
The model's performance may depend on the size and diversity of the pretraining corpus; future models with larger corpuses may improve predictions.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
